title: Authentication Failure
description: Procedure for diagnosing SSH, RADIUS, TACACS+, or admin credential brute-force or lockout events.
steps: Verify TACACS+/RADIUS server health and active directory integration
Analyze failed authentication source IP addresses for brute-force signatures
Check user account lockouts and TACACS+ key alignment
Verify management subnet ACLs on target gateway/switch
Review security audit logs and isolate unauthorized access attempts
